_comment: Tombaugh - SPHEREx blink comparator. Apache-2.0. AI-generated file: written by Claude (Anthropic) for team Missing Mass, NASA Space Apps 2026. Synthetic frames used by the cross-check. `args` goes straight into makeSyntheticMef (proxy/fixtures/synth.js); `id` is the frame id given to buildFrame; `fov` is the Grid width in arcmin used by the reprojection check.

synthetic.name: real-like
synthetic.note: Same geometry as the real file in CONTRACT.md: detector 2, cutout centre on detector pixel (1676, 539), roll 223.7 deg.

synthetic.name: south-wrap
synthetic.note: Southern field straddling RA = 0, detector 5, other roll, 0.2 deg cutout (117 pixels), target far from the detector centre.

synthetic.name: edge-clipped
synthetic.note: Target 10 pixels from the detector corner, so the cutout is clipped (NAXIS1 = 40, NAXIS2 = 37) as IRSA does.
